thesis: The episode explores the business model of Ladder, a platform connecting coaches with consumers to improve fitness efficiency and lower costs. It features a pitch-style conversation between venture capitalists Thatcher Bell and Taylor Greene and founder Brett Maloli, focusing on how the company generates data to improve the coaching process.
